options.text: They're still reviewing a few clauses.

options.text: The position is near the window.

qr.prompt: Wasn't the shipment supposed to arrive yesterday?

options.text: There was a delay at customs.

qr.prompt: Could you walk me through the new software?
qr.promptKo: 새 소프트웨어 사용법을 차근차근 알려 주실래요?

options.text: Sure, do you have twenty minutes now?
I walk to work every day.

qr.prompt: Why is the conference room locked?

options.text: I'll lock it after the meeting.

qr.prompt: Who approved this budget?
We're running low on printer ink.

options.text: I'll put in an order this afternoon.

qr.prompt: Shouldn't we get a second opinion before deciding?
qr.promptKo: 결정하기 전에 다른 의견도 들어 봐야 하지 않을까요?

options.text: The second floor, on the left.

qr.prompt: How did the presentation go?
Would you mind covering my shift on Saturday?
qr.promptKo: 토요일 제 근무 좀 대신해 줄 수 있어요?

options.ko: 미안해요, 그 주말엔 멀리 가 있어요.

qr.prompt: What would you like to focus on next year?

options.text: I focused really hard last night.
Leading a project from start to finish, ideally.
options.ko: 가능하면 프로젝트를 처음부터 끝까지 이끌어 보고 싶어요.

options.text: Next year is a leap year.

qr.prompt: I'm a bit worried about the cost.

options.text: That's fair. We could start with a smaller pilot.
options.ko: 그럴 만해요. 더 작은 시범 운영으로 시작할 수 있어요.

options.text: I'm worried about the weather too.

qr.prompt: Do you have something else lined up?

options.text: I lined up early for tickets.
Not yet, but I have a couple of interviews.
options.ko: 아직. 근데 면접이 두어 개 있어.

qr.prompt: Has the car ever been in an accident?
qr.promptKo: 이 차 사고 난 적 있어요?

options.text: Just a minor one, and it's all in the report.
options.ko: 가벼운 거 하나요, 보고서에 다 있어요.

qr.prompt: Would you consider a smaller increase?
qr.promptKo: 인상 폭을 줄여 주실 수 있나요?

options.text: If you sign for two years, I could do five percent.

qr.prompt: Our policy doesn't allow refunds for this fare.
qr.promptKo: 이 요금은 규정상 환불이 안 됩니다.

options.text: But you canceled the flight, not me.
options.ko: 그래도 결항은 제가 아니라 그쪽이 한 거잖아요.

qr.prompt: Could you break that quote down for me?
qr.promptKo: 그 견적을 항목별로 알려 주실 수 있나요?

options.text: It broke down on the highway.
Sure. About half is parts and half is labor.

qr.prompt: Do you think AI will replace your job?
qr.promptKo: AI가 당신 일을 대체할 것 같아요?

options.text: Some tasks, maybe, but not the whole job.
options.ko: 일부 업무는 그럴 수도 있지만 일 전체는 아니에요.

options.text: My job is in the city.

qr.prompt: Would you rather rent or buy?

options.text: Rent for now. I like the flexibility.

qr.prompt: Did I offend you in the meeting?

options.text: A little, but I know you didn't mean it personally.
options.ko: 조금요. 그래도 개인적인 뜻이 아니었던 거 알아요.

qr.prompt: Have you told your current employer yet?

options.text: Not yet. I'm giving notice on Monday.

qr.prompt: What's the downside of living there?

options.text: It's pretty far from the subway.

qr.prompt: Can I get an itemized receipt?

options.text: Of course, I'll email it to you.

qr.prompt: Congratulations on the promotion!

options.text: Thanks, I couldn't have done it without the team.
options.ko: 고마워요, 팀 없이는 못 했을 거예요.

options.text: I'm moving to the third floor.

lines.text: Kevin, the marketing campaign is already fifteen percent over budget, and we're only halfway through.
lines.ko: 케빈, 마케팅 캠페인이 아직 절반밖에 안 왔는데 벌써 예산을 15% 초과했어요.

lines.text: I know. The video production cost much more than the agency quoted.
lines.ko: 알아요. 영상 제작비가 대행사 견적보다 훨씬 많이 들었어요.

lines.text: Can we cut anything from the second half?
lines.ko: 후반부에서 뺄 수 있는 게 있을까요?

lines.text: We could drop the print ads. The online ads are performing better anyway.
lines.ko: 인쇄 광고를 뺄 수 있어요. 어차피 온라인 광고 성과가 더 좋거든요.

lines.text: Good. Put the numbers together and I'll take it to the director on Thursday.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 수치를 정리해 주면 목요일에 이사님께 가져갈게요.

questions.q: What is the main problem?
What caused the extra cost?
What will the woman do on Thursday?
options: Present the plan to the director

lines.text: I heard you got an offer from that startup. Are you taking it?
lines.ko: 그 스타트업에서 제안받았다며. 갈 거야?

lines.text: I'm torn. The salary's higher, but they want me to start in two weeks.
lines.ko: 고민 중이야. 연봉은 더 높은데 2주 안에 출근하래.

lines.text: Two weeks is tight. Would your current boss let you leave that quickly?
lines.ko: 2주는 빠듯하네. 지금 상사가 그렇게 빨리 보내 줄까?

lines.text: Probably not. I'm going to ask the startup if I can start next month instead.
lines.ko: 아마 안 될 거야. 대신 다음 달부터 시작해도 되는지 스타트업에 물어보려고.

questions.q: How does the man feel about the offer?
What is one concern about the offer?
options: The start date is very soon.

questions.q: What will the man probably do?
options: Ask for a later start date
Ask his boss for a raise

lines.text: I've called three times about my internet connection, and it still drops every evening.
lines.ko: 인터넷 연결 때문에 세 번이나 전화했는데 아직도 매일 저녁 끊겨요.

lines.text: I apologize for the trouble. I can see your previous tickets. It looks like the issue is with the line outside your building.
lines.ko: 불편을 드려 죄송합니다. 이전 접수 내역이 보이네요. 건물 밖 회선 문제로 보입니다.

lines.text: So when will it actually be fixed?
lines.ko: 그래서 실제로 언제 고쳐지나요?

lines.text: A technician can come Wednesday between nine and noon. I'll also credit one month of service to your account.
lines.ko: 수요일 9시에서 12시 사이에 기사가 방문할 수 있습니다. 한 달 이용료도 계정에 적립해 드릴게요.

questions.q: How many times has the customer called before?
What is causing the problem?
What will the company give the customer?

lines.text: Starting next quarter, we're changing how travel expenses are handled.
lines.ko: 다음 분기부터 출장비 처리 방식이 바뀝니다.

lines.text: Instead of paying upfront and waiting for reimbursement, employees will receive a company card.
lines.ko: 먼저 결제하고 환급을 기다리는 대신 직원들은 법인 카드를 받게 됩니다.

lines.text: All receipts must still be uploaded within five business days. Training sessions on the new system will be held next Tuesday and Wednesday.
lines.ko: 모든 영수증은 여전히 영업일 5일 이내에 올려야 합니다. 새 시스템 교육은 다음 주 화요일과 수요일에 열립니다.

questions.q: What is the announcement about?
What will employees receive?
When must receipts be uploaded?
options: By the end of the month

lines.text: Before we get back to the show, a word from our sponsor.
lines.ko: 방송으로 돌아가기 전에 후원사 소식입니다.

lines.text: Brightdesk is a standing desk that adjusts at the touch of a button. It's designed for small apartments and folds flat against the wall.
lines.ko: 브라이트데스크는 버튼 하나로 높이가 조절되는 스탠딩 책상입니다. 작은 집에 맞게 설계되어 벽에 납작하게 접힙니다.

lines.text: Listeners can get twenty percent off this month with the code SHOW twenty.
lines.ko: 청취자분들은 이번 달 코드 SHOW20으로 20% 할인을 받을 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
What is special about the product?
options: It folds flat against the wall.

questions.q: How can listeners get a discount?

lines.text: You're now standing in front of the museum's oldest exhibit, a fishing boat over two thousand years old.
lines.ko: 지금 박물관에서 가장 오래된 전시물인 2천 년이 넘은 고기잡이배 앞에 서 계십니다.

lines.text: It was discovered in nineteen ninety-four when workers were building a new harbor.
lines.ko: 이 배는 1994년 새 항구를 짓던 인부들에게 발견됐습니다.

lines.text: Because the wood is so fragile, the room is kept cool and dark. Please don't use flash photography here.
lines.ko: 나무가 매우 약해서 이 방은 서늘하고 어둡게 유지됩니다. 여기서는 플래시 촬영을 하지 마세요.

questions.q: What is the exhibit?
How was it found?
Why is the room kept cool and dark?

lines.text: I'm afraid I need to raise the rent by two hundred starting in March. Property taxes went up again.
lines.ko: 죄송하지만 3월부터 월세를 200 올려야 해요. 재산세가 또 올랐어요.

lines.text: I understand, but that's almost a fifteen percent increase. I've never been late with a payment.
lines.ko: 이해하지만 거의 15퍼센트 인상이에요. 저는 한 번도 연체한 적이 없어요.

lines.text: That's true. You've been a great tenant. What did you have in mind?
lines.ko: 맞아요. 정말 좋은 세입자셨죠. 생각하신 게 있어요?

lines.text: If I sign a two-year lease, could we make it one hundred instead?
lines.ko: 2년 계약하면 100으로 해 주실 수 있을까요?

lines.text: Let's say one twenty, and I'll repaint the living room before summer.
lines.ko: 120으로 하죠. 그리고 여름 전에 거실 페인트를 새로 칠해 드릴게요.

questions.q: Why is the rent going up?
What does the tenant offer?
What will the landlord do before summer?

lines.text: So the main idea is to move a third of your ad budget from search to short-form video.
lines.ko: 핵심은 광고 예산의 3분의 1을 검색에서 숏폼 영상으로 옮기는 거예요.

lines.text: That's a big shift. Our board is quite conservative about trying new channels.
lines.ko: 큰 변화네요. 저희 이사회는 새 채널에 꽤 보수적이에요.

lines.text: Then we could run a three-month test in just one region and share weekly results.
lines.ko: 그럼 한 지역에서만 3개월 테스트를 하고 매주 결과를 공유할 수 있어요.

lines.text: That would be much easier to approve. Can you send a short proposal by Friday?
lines.ko: 그게 훨씬 승인받기 쉽겠네요. 금요일까지 짧은 제안서를 보내 줄 수 있어요?

questions.q: What does the agency want to change?
options: Where the ad budget is spent

questions.q: What is the client's concern?
What will the agency send by Friday?

lines.text: Your front tires are worn, the brake pads are thin, and there's a small coolant leak.
lines.ko: 앞 타이어가 닳았고 브레이크 패드가 얇아졌고 냉각수가 조금 새요.

lines.text: How much would it be to fix all of that? I just paid for a new battery last month.
lines.ko: 다 고치면 얼마예요? 지난달에 배터리를 새로 갈았는데요.

lines.text: Around eleven hundred, but the brakes are the only thing that really can't wait.
lines.ko: 1,100 정도예요. 하지만 정말 미룰 수 없는 건 브레이크뿐이에요.

lines.text: Then let's do the brakes today and the rest after payday.
lines.ko: 그럼 오늘은 브레이크만 하고 나머지는 월급날 이후에 할게요.

questions.q: What did the woman replace last month?
Which repair is most urgent?
When will she fix the other problems?

lines.text: We're considering Daniel for a team lead role. How was he at managing people?
lines.ko: 다니엘을 팀장 자리에 고려 중이에요. 사람 관리는 어땠나요?

lines.text: He was great at giving clear feedback, and his team trusted him completely.
lines.ko: 명확한 피드백을 잘 줬고 팀원들이 완전히 신뢰했어요.

lines.text: Was there anything he struggled with?
lines.ko: 어려워한 부분이 있었나요?

lines.text: Saying no to other departments. He sometimes took on too much and his team got overloaded.
lines.ko: 다른 부서에 거절하는 거요. 가끔 일을 너무 많이 받아서 팀이 과부하됐어요.

questions.q: What role is Daniel being considered for?
What was Daniel good at?
What did he struggle with?

lines.text: They offered me the Berlin position. It's a two-year contract with housing included.
lines.ko: 베를린 자리를 제안받았어. 주거 포함 2년 계약이야.

lines.text: That's incredible! But what about your apartment here and your cat?
lines.ko: 대단하다! 근데 여기 집이랑 고양이는?

lines.text: I could sublet the apartment, and my sister already said she'd take care of Mochi.
lines.ko: 집은 전대하면 되고, 모찌는 언니가 이미 돌봐 주겠다고 했어.

lines.text: Sounds like you've already decided. When do you leave?
lines.ko: 이미 결정한 것 같네. 언제 떠나?

lines.text: Probably early January, right after the holidays.
lines.ko: 아마 1월 초, 연휴 끝나자마자.

questions.q: What is included in the offer?
Who will take care of the cat?
When will she leave?

lines.text: Good morning, everyone. Starting next quarter, we're moving to a hybrid model with three office days a week.
lines.ko: 좋은 아침입니다. 다음 분기부터 주 3일 출근하는 하이브리드 근무로 바뀝니다.

lines.text: Each team can choose its own days, but Tuesday will be a company-wide office day for meetings.
lines.ko: 팀별로 요일을 정할 수 있지만 화요일은 회의를 위한 전사 출근일입니다.

lines.text: We'll review the policy in six months based on your feedback, so please fill out the survey.
lines.ko: 여러분의 의견을 바탕으로 6개월 뒤 정책을 재검토할 예정이니 설문에 꼭 참여해 주세요.

questions.q: How many office days will there be per week?
What is special about Tuesday?
When will the policy be reviewed?

lines.text: Hello, this is a message from Riverside Clinic about your annual checkup next Thursday at eight.
lines.ko: 리버사이드 병원에서 다음 주 목요일 8시 정기 검진에 대해 안내드립니다.

lines.text: Please don't eat or drink anything except water for twelve hours before your blood test.
lines.ko: 혈액 검사 전 12시간 동안 물 외에는 아무것도 드시지 마세요.

lines.text: If you need to reschedule, call us at least forty-eight hours in advance to avoid a cancellation fee.
lines.ko: 일정 변경이 필요하면 취소 수수료를 피하기 위해 최소 48시간 전에 전화해 주세요.

questions.q: When is the checkup?
What can the patient have before the test?
questions.qKo: 검사 전 먹을 수 있는 것은?

questions.q: How can patients avoid a fee?

lines.text: Rents in the city rose another seven percent this year, the biggest jump in over a decade.
lines.ko: 올해 도시 월세가 또 7퍼센트 올라 10여 년 만에 가장 큰 폭을 기록했습니다.

lines.text: Experts say the main cause is a shortage of new apartments, especially smaller units for young workers.
lines.ko: 전문가들은 신규 아파트, 특히 젊은 직장인용 소형 주택 부족을 주원인으로 꼽습니다.

lines.text: The city plans to build five thousand affordable homes, but most won't be ready until twenty twenty-nine.
lines.ko: 시는 저렴한 주택 5천 호를 지을 계획이지만 대부분 2029년에야 완공됩니다.

questions.q: How much did rents rise this year?
What is the main cause, according to experts?
When will most of the new homes be ready?

lines.text: Thank you for calling. We're aware of an outage affecting customers in the north district since six p.m.
lines.ko: 전화 주셔서 감사합니다. 오후 6시부터 북부 지역 고객에게 영향을 주는 장애를 확인했습니다.

lines.text: Our engineers are working on it, and we expect service to return by midnight.
lines.ko: 엔지니어들이 작업 중이며 자정까지는 복구될 것으로 예상합니다.

lines.text: Affected customers will automatically receive a one-day credit on their next bill.
lines.ko: 영향을 받은 고객은 다음 청구서에 하루치 요금이 자동으로 차감됩니다.

questions.q: Who is affected by the outage?
When should service return?
What will affected customers get?

lines.text: Welcome to the November meeting of our book club. This month we're discussing a novel about two sisters in post-war Japan.
lines.ko: 11월 독서 모임에 오신 걸 환영해요. 이번 달엔 전후 일본의 두 자매 이야기를 다룬 소설을 이야기합니다.

lines.text: We'll start with first impressions, then talk about the ending, which I know many of you have strong feelings about.
lines.ko: 첫인상부터 시작해서, 많은 분이 할 말이 많을 결말 이야기를 할 거예요.

lines.text: Next month's book was chosen by vote, and it's a short memoir, so it should be a quick read.
lines.ko: 다음 달 책은 투표로 정한 짧은 회고록이라 금방 읽으실 거예요.

questions.q: What is this month's book about?
What will they discuss second?
What kind of book is next month's?
